generator: phrase-match: scripts retrieve (data/idioms.json v1, lookup score 100), the model selects the reading and ranks analogs

prompt_components.purpose: Register-faithful, context-correct rendering; register fidelity matters more than literal meaning
task_decomposition: list all readings of the phrase
state which reading the context selects and why
rank target-language analogs by register and pragmatics
prompt_components.output_contract: each entry in analyses[]: context → reading_selected + evidence, readings_rejected, ranked analogs per language with register/pragmatics/sources, escape-hatch status
prompt_components.contrastive_example: analyses[] itself: the same phrase under two contexts yields different renderings
prompt_components.escape_hatch: if no idiomatic equivalent exists, escape_hatch_used=true and only register-matched paraphrases (sources: []) are offered — presented as paraphrases, never as cited facts
prompt_components.grounding_rule: every URL below returned HTTP 200 to scripts/verify_refs.py on verification.checked; analogs without sources are explicitly unverified

analyses.context: Да брось ты, отдохни — перекур! От работы кони дохнут.
analyses.evidence: «брось», «отдохни», «перекур» — jocular invitation to slack off; the proverb is used as a humorous justification

readings_rejected.reason: nothing in the context signals health danger or genuine concern; the tone is light

analyses.register_gap: both analogs are noticeably milder than the coarse-ironic Russian original («дохнут» is blunt); say so when translating

de.text: Arbeit allein macht auch nicht glücklich.
de.pragmatics: same anti-overwork stance, milder tone; dict.cc pairs it with 'All work and no play (makes Jack a dull boy)'

en.text: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
en.pragmatics: same anti-overwork stance but much milder; flag the register gap to the reader

analyses.context: Врач предупредил: с такими переработками ты заработаешь выгорание.

readings_rejected.reason: a jocular rendering would clash with the medical-warning tone of the context

analyses.escape_hatch_reason: no established English or German proverb carries the serious reading with the same force; register-matched paraphrases are offered instead and must never be presented as cited equivalents

de.text: Man kann sich auch zu Tode arbeiten.
de.pragmatics: paraphrase built on the common verb 'sich zu Tode arbeiten' (to work oneself to death)

en.text: Working yourself to death helps no one.
